text: {"observations": [{"unit_ids": ["Da3ecb9ae0f.P108.S001"], "anchor": "Just last month we introduced bonuses to recruit and retain qualified early years teachers where they are needed most.", "reason": "Do financial bonuses for early years teachers in underserved areas improve recruitment, retention, and child outcomes?"},{"unit_ids": ["Da3ecb9ae0f.P130.S001", "Da3ecb9ae0f.P131.S001", "Da3ecb9ae0f.P132.S001", "Da3ecb9ae0f.P133.S001"], "anchor": null, "reason": "Do Best Start Family Hubs providing integrated family support improve early childhood and parental labour market outcomes?"},{"unit_ids": ["Da3ecb9ae0f.P153.S001", "Da3ecb9ae0f.P154.S001"], "anchor": null, "reason": "Does government-funded childcare rollout improve maternal employment and children's early development outcomes?"},{"unit_ids": ["Da3ecb9ae0f.P155.S001", "Da3ecb9ae0f.P156.S001", "Da3ecb9ae0f.P157.S001"], "anchor": null, "reason": "Does extending funded childcare to non-working low-income families increase parental employment and child development outcomes?"},{"unit_ids": ["Da3ecb9ae0f.P158.S001", "Da3ecb9ae0f.P159.S001"], "anchor": null, "reason": "What are the costs and benefits of moving to a universal early years education system?"},{"unit_ids": ["Da3ecb9ae0f.P198.S001"], "anchor": "I will continue the change that we've begun in our colleges, backed by a record £18 billion investment in the skills system, and brand-new V-levels, giving our young people the choices they need to succeed.", "reason": "Does increased investment in vocational and technical education improve labour market outcomes for young people?"},{"unit_ids": ["Da3ecb9ae0f.P202.S001"], "anchor": null, "reason": "Do free breakfast clubs, expanded free school meals, and lifting the two-child benefit limit reduce child poverty and improve educational attainment?"}]}
